title: Notion notes mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from the Notion notes mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod. "none": only where a layout or another mod puts it.

focusable.description: Lets pane.go give a shown copy the keyboard.

settings.description: Your changes. A setting left out uses its default.

parents.title: Parents
parents.description: Where new pages go: [{ "name": "Inbox", "ref": "page:<id>" }], ref being page:<id>, database:<id> or data-source:<id>. None: private workspace pages.

datasource.title: Data source
datasource.description: Data source (or database) id the picker lists when the query is empty. Empty: recently edited pages.

ntn.title: Notion CLI
ntn.description: The ntn command, or its full path.

font_size.title: Font size
font_size.description: Size of this mod's main text in px; smaller and larger text keep their proportion to it.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Scales this mod's icons, buttons and row heights. 1 is Herdr's own size.
